items.title: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
items.description: The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the wars which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
items.description: The Trump-Lula relationship may have thawed, but several issues could reignite tensions between the two leaders.

items.title: Truce begins in Ukraine city where residents ate weeds to survive
items.description: The Oleshky ceasefire, which the White House said was secured by US First Lady Melania Trump, is meant to allow aid to get in and civilians to get out.

items.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
items.description: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.

items.title: Ex-FBI chief James Comey faces federal charges for third time
items.description: Comey's lawyers say the case stems from alleged disclosure of classified information to the New York Times in 2016.

items.title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show
items.description: The rapper has been involved with the show for years but has never before performed at the NFL championship game.

items.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
items.description: The France star had referred to the former Chinese leader as a "dictator" during an interview about memes.

items.title: Netherlands pulls out of Eurovision again over Israel participation
items.description: A Dutch broadcaster reverses a decision to take part, citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation.

items.title: Co-ordinated cattle raids kill at least 72 people in South Sudan
items.description: The cycle of revenge attacks continue as the country heads towards its first  election since independence.

items.title: Meghan to co-host Junior MasterChef Australia
items.description: The Duchess of Sussex says she "can't wait" to take part in the programme, which will air next year.

items.title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year
items.description: "Whatever we're doing, we want to push it further," said an expert on why Americans are embracing the term, which is short for maximising.

items.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
items.description: Maurene Comey believes she was let go from her job as a federal prosecutor because her father is the former FBI director.
